latest_release.name: Savage Wind 0.5.3 (0.5.3-alpha.5)
latest_release.body:
**Savage Wind 0.5.3: quick fixes.**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of the game, updated to **version 1.9.0**
> (and the DLC, version 3.0, if you want it), extracted from **your own** Nintendo Switch. Savage Wind provides no game
> files, keys, firmware, dumping or decryption tools, or instructions to obtain any of them, and it never decrypts
> anything. The game code is recompiled on your machine, from your files, for your own use only: don't share it.
> Respect the copyright laws of your country. This is a fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

## Downloads

| File | For | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `SavageWind-0.5.3-alpha.5-windows.zip` | Windows 10 or later, x86-64 | Supported |
| `Savage_Wind-0.5.3-alpha.5-x86_64.AppImage` | Linux x86-64 with glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36, Arch, SteamOS...) | Supported |
| `Savage_Wind-0.5.3-alpha.5-aarch64.AppImage` | Linux on ARM64 with a Vulkan 1.3 driver | **Highly experimental** |

The `.sig` files next to them are what Savage Wind checks before it installs an update: you don't need them.

## Updating to 0.5.3

**From 0.5.1 or 0.5.2:** Savage Wind Configuration offers it: press **Update**. Your game files, saves and settings stay.

**From 0.5.0 or older:** by hand, once: extract the zip over your old folder (Windows), or use the new AppImage (Linux).

**Stuck at 99% right now:** close Savage Wind (with Task Manager if it doesn't close), then extract the 0.5.3 zip over
your Savage Wind folder and start it again.

## Fixes

- **Setup stuck at 99%** while precompiling shaders, on AMD cards with Windows after updating to 0.5.2 (21502 of 21503
  pipelines), where Esc could not stop it either ([#359](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/359)). A
  shader compile the graphics driver never finishes no longer holds setup up: after 3 minutes without progress, or when
  you press Esc, setup goes on without it, and `savagewind.log` names the shader.
- **Rain and torch particles** stretched across the screen for a frame
  ([#620](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/620), [#629](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/629),
  [#683](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/683), [#717](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/717)).
  If you set `SAVAGEWIND_GPU_OVERLAP=0` for this, please remove it: it costs a lot of frame rate, and the fix costs
  about 1%.

## Still open

The **black, dark or wrong sky on AMD cards with Windows** (RX 6000 and older) is not fixed: the 0.5.2 change did not do
it. If you have it, please follow the steps on [#359](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/359).

## Found a bug?

Open a [bug report](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/new/choose) with `savagewind.log`, or make one zip with **Options > Problem report**. If an update fails, `SW Update.log` in the Savage Wind folder says why.

## Thanks

To everyone who reported these with logs, videos and tests, so quickly.

This release was made almost entirely with AI (Anthropic's Claude, through Claude Code), directed, tested and
reviewed by a human.
